Project.description: Infrastructure construction and civil engineering works executed or bid by National Infrastructure Corp. Ltd. between 2010 and 2025 across Indian states.
Project.naming_convention: {Project Type} — {State} Pkg-{Number} (e.g., 'Greenfield Expressway — West Bengal Pkg-110', 'RCC Bridge — Gujarat Pkg-1')

relationships.description: Each project is commissioned by a government department or private developer.
Each project is led by a designated Project Manager/Project Lead.
Each project corresponds to a contract or package ID.
Projects under formal contract may have bank guarantees issued.
Client testimonial verifying successful handover (132/155 works).
Formal sign-off containing client grading and final values.

Client.description: Government departments, statutory authorities, state municipal corporations, and private engineering enterprises that tender, award, and finance infrastructure projects.
Client.naming_convention: Official institutional names including state or corporate suffixes (e.g., 'National Special Projects Office', 'Jal Nigam, Jharkhand', 'Public Health Engineering Dept, Gujarat', 'Lakshya Engineering & Construction')

relationships.description: A client awards multiple packages or project contracts.
Issues official completion certificates and assigns performance grades.
Provides formal recommendation letters on request.
Receives RA bills and makes milestone payments recorded in receivables ageing.

Engineer.description: Key technical personnel and Project Managers employed by National Infrastructure Corp. Ltd. responsible for site execution, project delivery, and statutory compliance.
Engineer.naming_convention: Full proper personal names (e.g., 'Asha Nair', 'Chandan Banerjee', 'Neha Chopra', 'Rahul Menon', 'Gautam Joshi', 'Naveen Roy', 'Suresh Desai')

relationships.description: Leads execution of specific infrastructure projects.
Holds PMP, Six Sigma Black Belt, or other professional credentials.
Belongs to a specific corporate business unit.

Certificate.description: Professional certifications, accreditations, and qualifications held by employees (e.g., PMP, Six Sigma Black Belt) or company-wide quality accreditations (ISO 9001, 14001, 45001).

relationships.description: Associated with a specific employee ID and name.
Issue date acts as a temporal benchmark for qualifying projects led post-certification.

Tender.description: Formal bidding opportunities and RFPs issued by government clients for which National Infrastructure Corp. Ltd. prepared bids, compliance matrices, and bank guarantees.

relationships.description: Tender issued by client authority.
Tender mandates earnest money deposit or performance bank guarantee.

Bank.description: Commercial and public sector banking institutions providing current accounts, credit facilities, and issuing performance bank guarantees / letters of credit.
Bank.naming_convention: Commercial bank names (e.g., 'Kalinga National Bank', 'Union Trust Bank of India')

relationships.description: Issues irrevocable bank guarantees on behalf of contractor.
Underlies Bank Asset account 1010 and statement cash movements.

Performance Grade.description: Qualitative assessment awarded by the commissioning client officer on completion certificates evaluating the quality of execution, adherence to milestones, and contractor co-operation.

relationships.description: Defines the client's qualitative score for that completed work.

Performance Bond.description: Irrevocable, unconditional bank guarantee issued on non-judicial stamp paper against a specific contract or tender to secure performance obligations (typically 5% or 10% of contract value).

relationships.description: Guaranteed by issuing bank.
Secures bid/contract under specific RFP reference.

BOQ Item.description: Bill of Quantities line item specifying work descriptions, standard units of measurement, schedule rates, executed quantities, and billed amounts.
BOQ Item.naming_convention: Item number with standard civil engineering descriptions (e.g., 'Earthwork in excavation', 'Wet mix macadam (WMM)', 'RCC M30 for structures', 'Reinforcement steel Fe500')

relationships.description: Belongs to a project contract BOQ schedule.

Invoice.description: Running Account (RA) bills and statutory tax invoices submitted to clients claiming interim or final payment for executed work.

relationships.description: Claimed from project client.
Billed against contract work.

Ledger Entry.description: Double-entry bookkeeping journal transaction posted to company general ledger accounts recording revenue, expenses, asset additions, taxes, and bank transfers.
Ledger Entry.naming_convention: Voucher / Narration with Date, Debit, Credit, Running Balance

relationships.description: Account 1010 postings map directly to bank statement deposits/withdrawals.

Asset / Plant & Equipment.description: Heavy civil construction machinery, vehicles, batching plants, and equipment owned or leased by National Infrastructure Corp. Ltd.
Asset / Plant & Equipment.naming_convention: Asset ID (1..N) with Type, Make, Acquisition Year, Cost, Condition, Location State, Ownership (owned/leased), Safety Certification status

relationships.description: Located in specific operational state.

Business Unit.description: Internal operational division within National Infrastructure Corp. Ltd. specializing in distinct infrastructure verticals.
Business Unit.naming_convention: Vertical names: 'Civil Construction & Infrastructure', 'Specialized Technical Services', 'Water & Environmental Engineering', 'Roads & Highways', 'Bridges & Structures', 'Industrial EPC'

relationships.description: Houses project engineers and technical teams.

Location / State.description: Geographical Indian state or union territory where construction projects are sited, assets are deployed, or clients are based.
Location / State.naming_convention: Indian State names: 'West Bengal', 'Uttar Pradesh', 'Jharkhand', 'Gujarat', 'Maharashtra', 'Madhya Pradesh', 'Odisha', 'Tamil Nadu', 'Bihar', 'Delhi'

relationships.description: State where infrastructure package is constructed.
